welcome.title: Welcome to {{appName}}!
welcome.subtitle: Learn to play the piano – on your real piano. I'll listen and help you along.
welcome.passkeyHint: With fingerprint, face or device PIN – no password needed.
welcome.registrationClosed: New accounts cannot be created at the moment.

email.title: Sign in with e-mail
email.codeSent: If the address is valid, we've sent you a 6-digit code.
email.needsName: There is no account for this address yet. What is your name?
email.registerIntro: Enter your e-mail address. We will send you a code to confirm your account. You can set up a passkey afterwards under “Account”.
email.loginIntro: We will send a 6-digit code to your e-mail address.
email.nameHint: Your name is only shown in the app. For a family account, e.g. “The Smiths”.
email.registrationClosed: New accounts cannot be created at the moment. Existing accounts can still sign in.

profiles.title: Who's playing today?
profiles.name: Name
profiles.modeHint: Lessons are the same in both styles.
profiles.empty: Create a profile for everyone who learns – for example you and your kids.
profiles.passkeyNudge: Tip: set up a passkey and next time you sign in with your fingerprint or face – no e-mail code needed.

dashboard.mascotKids: Great to see you! Ready for the next lesson?
dashboard.micSetup: First set up the microphone so I can hear your piano well. It takes about a minute.
dashboard.allDone: You have finished all lessons! New ones are coming soon.
dashboard.streakKeep: Play again tomorrow and your fire grows!
dashboard.streakZero: Play today – and your fire starts burning!
dashboard.micSetupShort: Set up the microphone once – then I can hear your piano better.

account.title: Account
account.passkeysHint: With a passkey you sign in using your fingerprint, face or device PIN – faster than an e-mail code. Set one up on every device you practise with.
account.emailHint: Used to sign in with a code when no passkey is at hand.
account.dangerHint: Deletes your account with all profiles and progress. This cannot be undone.
account.noPasskeys: No passkey set up yet. Until then you sign in with an e-mail code.
account.name: Account name
account.nameHint: Only shown in the app, for example “The Smiths”.

admin.title: Administration
admin.registrationOpenHint: When switched off, no new accounts can be created. Existing accounts can still sign in with a passkey or e-mail code.

errors.EMAIL_CODE_INVALID: The code is wrong or has expired.
errors.EMAIL_IN_USE: This e-mail address is already in use.
errors.TOO_MANY_CODES: Too many codes requested. Please wait a few minutes.
errors.PASSKEY_UNKNOWN: We don't know this passkey. Maybe it was deleted?
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
errors.REGISTRATION_CLOSED: New accounts cannot be created at the moment.
errors.BAD_DATE: The date on your device seems to be wrong.
errors.NETWORK: No connection to the server. Check the internet connection and try again.
errors.PARENT_LOCKED: This is the parent area. Please enter the parent PIN first.

validation.name: Please enter a name (max. 40 characters).
validation.email: Please enter a valid e-mail address.

mic.title: Microphone test
mic.intro: Play a few notes on your piano. Here you can see what the app hears.
mic.gateHint: Notes are only analysed above the marker (above the room noise).
mic.notCalibrated: The microphone is not set up for this profile yet. Detection works anyway, but becomes more reliable after setup.

errors.MIC_UNSUPPORTED: This browser cannot use the microphone here. Please use an up-to-date browser over a secure connection (https).
errors.MIC_DENIED: Access to the microphone was denied. Allow it in the browser settings (on iPad: Settings → Safari → Microphone) and try again.
errors.MIC_FAILED: The microphone could not be started. Please try again.

micSetup.title: Set up microphone
micSetup.intro: In four short steps I get to know your piano and your room.
micSetup.micText: Place the device on the music stand or near the piano. Then allow access to the microphone.
micSetup.noiseText: Please be completely quiet for {{seconds}} seconds. I am listening to how loud the room is.
micSetup.noiseOk: Good, the room is quiet ({{db}} dBFS).
micSetup.noiseLoud: It is quite loud ({{db}} dBFS). Detection works, but is more reliable in a quieter room.
micSetup.tuningText: Play the A to the right of middle C (marked yellow) and hold the key until the bar is full.
micSetup.keepHolding: Good, keep holding the key a little longer …
micSetup.tuningResult: Your piano is tuned to A = {{hz}} Hz ({{cents}} cents compared to 440 Hz).
micSetup.tuningFar: That is quite far off. Was it really the A? Otherwise try again.
micSetup.testText: Now play {{count}} different notes, one after the other.
micSetup.testOk: Great, I can hear you well!

input.title: How do you play?
input.intro: Klavio listens through the microphone or reads your digital piano via MIDI. The on-screen keyboard always works.
input.priority: If a MIDI device is connected, it takes priority. The microphone is then ignored, because it would hear the digital piano a second time.
input.ignoredEcho: that was the sound of the on-screen keyboard.

midi.title: Digital piano (MIDI)
midi.text: Most accurate: connect your digital piano via USB or Bluetooth.
midi.none: No MIDI device found. Connect your digital piano and switch it on – it will appear automatically.
midi.unsupported: This browser does not support MIDI (e.g. Safari on iPad and iPhone, or Firefox). Use the microphone, or Chrome or Edge.
midi.denied: Access to MIDI was denied. Allow it in the browser settings.

mic.title: Microphone
mic.text: For an acoustic piano: the device listens when no MIDI device is connected.
mic.calibrated: Set up, concert pitch A = {{hz}} Hz.

screen.title: On-screen keyboard
screen.text: Tap the keys – to try things out or when no piano is around.
screen.keys: On a computer the keyboard plays too: A S D F G H J K are the white keys from middle C, W E T Y U the black ones.

path.goal: Goal of chapter {{n}}: not reached yet

lesson.inputMidi: I can hear your digital piano ({{device}}).
lesson.inputMic: I am listening through the microphone – just play your piano.
lesson.inputMicSetup: Tip: set up the microphone once and I will recognise you even better.
lesson.inputScreen: Play on the keyboard here on the screen.
lesson.useScreen: You can keep playing on the on-screen keyboard.
lesson.switchToScreen: Switch off the microphone and play on the screen
lesson.hint: Look, the marked key helps you.
lesson.wrongPlay: That was {{note}}. Try the marked key.
lesson.moreStars: Play the lesson again to collect more stars.
lesson.readNote: Which note is this? Play it!
lesson.playSong: Play the song – I will wait for you
lesson.songStaffLabel: Notes of the song, line {{line}} of {{lines}}

improvise.ready: Ready? I play an accompaniment – you play freely on the black keys.
improvise.more: Lovely! Play a bit more next time – at least {{min}} notes.

lesson.micMelodyOnly: With the microphone, the melody counts here.

offline.synced: {{count}} lesson played offline has been saved.
offline.synced_other: {{count}} lessons played offline have been saved.
offline.pendingResult: You are offline right now. Your result is stored on this device and will be sent once you are back online. Badges will follow then.

install.title: Install Klavio
install.text: Install the app: it then starts like a real app in full screen and also works without internet.
install.ios: In Safari, tap “Share” (square with an arrow) and then “Add to Home Screen”. Klavio then starts like a real app and also works without internet.

about.title: About {{appName}}
about.text: {{appName}} is free software under the GNU Affero General Public License (AGPL-3.0). You may use, adapt and share it; anyone offering a modified version online must make its source code available too.

parent.title: Parent area
parent.forgot: Forgot the PIN? Sign out and sign in again with a passkey or e-mail code – then you can set a new one under “Account”.
parent.explain: A parent PIN (4 digits) protects the account, administration and creating profiles from little hands. Learning and the microphone setup work without the PIN.
parent.isSet: The parent PIN is set. The parent area closes as soon as a profile is chosen, and after 15 minutes at the latest.
parent.mismatch: The two PINs do not match.

profileSettings.title: My profile
profileSettings.figureOnly: You can choose your figure yourself. Your parents change the name, display mode and daily goal.
profileSettings.deleteHint: Deletes the profile “{{name}}” with all progress and badges. This cannot be undone.
profileSettings.eggTune: {{name}} dances and plays a tune for you! 🎶
profileSettings.eggDisco: Disco mode! 🪩 Let the colours dance.

theory.title: Discover
theory.handNumbers: Right hand from above: thumb 1, index finger 2, middle finger 3, ring finger 4, little finger 5
theory.handMarked: Right hand from above, one finger is marked
theory.clapAgain: Almost! Listen to the clicks and try again.
theory.staffLines: Staff with the lines marked. Notes: {{notes}}
theory.staffSpaces: Staff with the spaces marked. Notes: {{notes}}
theory.handNumbersLeft: Left hand from above: thumb 1, index finger 2, middle finger 3, ring finger 4, little finger 5
theory.handMarkedLeft: Left hand from above, one finger is marked

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.intro: Everything you have discovered so far – to look up again.

review.title: Review today
review.intro: These lessons are due again – so you don't forget anything.
review.quickIntro: Nothing is due today. Up for a quick round?
review.quickEmpty: Play a few lessons first – then there will be questions about them here.
review.done: Well reviewed! You get {{xp}} bonus XP.

landing.headline: Learn piano – on a real piano, like a game.
landing.lead: Klavio listens while you play, shows you step by step what comes next and guides you through colourful worlds – from your first key to playing with both hands.

profile.title: Create a profile
profile.text: One account for the family, one profile for everyone – each with their own figure.

stand.title: Put it on the music stand
stand.text: Place a tablet, phone or laptop on the piano. A digital piano works by cable too.

play.title: Play – Klavio listens
play.text: You play on your piano, Klavio recognises the notes and helps you along.

listen.title: Listens to you
listen.text: Note detection with the microphone, MIDI for digital pianos, or the on-screen keyboard.

worlds.title: {{count}} worlds
worlds.text: From Key Valley to Starry Night: a learning path like a board game.

discover.title: Discover & knowledge
discover.text: Short explanations, quizzes and little games before every lesson – collected to look up again.

review.title: Review
review.text: Lessons you played come back at the right time – so everything sticks.

medals.title: Medals & stars
medals.text: Stars, levels, a daily goal and medals to collect – without any pressure.

family.title: For the whole family
family.text: Several profiles, a kids and a classic look, a parents' area with a PIN.

landing.worldsText: Every chapter is a world of its own. Worlds you haven't reached yet lie in the fog – until you discover them.
landing.tryHint: Do you know a children's song? Why not play it …

privacy.audio: What you play stays on your device – audio is never sent or stored.
privacy.data: Only what's needed: no date of birth, a first name is enough for children.
privacy.open: Free software (AGPL-3.0) – the source code is open.

piano.q: Do I need a digital piano?
piano.a: No. A real piano is enough – the microphone recognises the notes. You can connect a digital piano via USB MIDI, and there is an on-screen keyboard to try things out.

who.a: For children and adults without prior knowledge. Everyone gets their own profile – children a playful look, adults a calm one if they like.

devices.q: Which devices does Klavio run on?
devices.a: In any current browser on a tablet, phone or computer. You can also install Klavio like an app.

offline.a: Yes. Lessons work offline, and your results are sent as soon as you're back online.

landing.eggKonami: Secret code cracked! 🎉 You're a real pro.
landing.eggKlavi: Klavi plays “Für Elise” – just for you! 🎵
landing.eggDucks: All my little ducklings are swimming on the lake! 🦆

goal.percent: {{percent}} % of the way to your dream song
goal.ready: You can do everything “{{title}}” needs. Time for your dream song! 🎉
goal.waiting: The next skills come in new worlds – keep going!
goal.promptText: Is there a dream song you'd like to play one day?
goal.editorIntro: Which song would you like to play one day? Klavio shows you along the way how close you are.
goal.songTitleHint: Start typing – Klavio suggests well-known songs. For example “Nothing Else Matters”.
goal.style: What kind of piece is it?
goal.needsHint: A suggestion for this song – adjust it as you like. Basics like reading notes are always included.
goal.copyright: Klavio only stores the title – no notes. You get the sheet music of your dream song yourself later, for example as an “easy piano” edition.
goal.recognized: Recognised: “{{title}}” by {{artist}} – kind of piece and skills are suggested. You can adjust them.
goal.recognizedNoArtist: Recognised: “{{title}}” – kind of piece and skills are suggested. You can adjust them.
goal.guessed: Klavio doesn't know this song exactly but made a suggestion from the title. Give it a quick check.
goal.unknown: Klavio doesn't know this song – choose the kind of piece and what it needs below.
goal.fuzzy: Do you mean “{{title}}” by {{artist}}? Kind of piece and skills are suggested.
goal.fuzzyNoArtist: Do you mean “{{title}}”? Kind of piece and skills are suggested.

speech.autoHint: Tasks and explanations are read aloud automatically – handy for children who can't read yet. The voice comes from the device and the text never leaves it. While Klavi speaks, the microphone briefly stops listening.
speech.noVoice: This device has no voice installed for this language. You can add text-to-speech in the device settings.
